description: This Kotlin source file defines the TransactionsState class which manages financial transactions, including adding income and expenses, filtering by month, and calculating totals, using the Jetpack Compose runtime for state management.

classes.name: TransactionsState
classes.description: A class managing a list of financial transactions with filtering, totaling, and state management functionalities.

methods.name: setMonth
methods.description: Sets the selected month for filtering transactions.

methods.name: addIncome
methods.description: Adds a new income transaction with specified date, description, and amount.

methods.name: addExpense
methods.description: Adds a new expense transaction with specified date, description, and amount.

methods.name: monthTransactions
methods.description: Returns the list of transactions for the selected month, sorted by date descending.

methods.name: incomeTotal
methods.description: Calculates the total income for the selected month.

methods.name: expenseTotal
methods.description: Calculates the total expenses for the selected month.

methods.name: netBalance
methods.description: Calculates the net balance (income minus expenses) for the selected month.
